name: Centro León
known: Its first director was Rafael Emilio Yunén Zoain (2002 to 2014), and María Amalia León now heads it.

Three permanent exhibitions (Signos de Identidad, Génesis y Trayectoria, Huella y Memoria), a separate exhibition on the founder and the family business (AFAR), a Mediateca of 37,000 volumes, gardens and the Concurso de Arte Eduardo León Jimenes, created in 1964 (Acento).

name: Museo de Arte Moderno de Santo Domingo
known: Museum director Federico Fondeur and curator Ana A.

name: Bienal de Cuenca
known: Seventeen curators each chose three artists, at least one Ecuadorian, for 51 artists in total.
Hernán Pacurucu became executive director of the foundation in 2023 (The Art Newspaper).

name: Museo Antropológico y de Arte Contemporáneo (MAAC)
Centro de Arte Contemporáneo de Quito
Museo Nacional del Ecuador (MuNa)
known: Opened on 1 December 1969 as the Museo Arqueológico y Galerías de Arte Guillermo Pérez Chiriboga, founded by the Banco Central del Ecuador on the fifth and sixth floors of the bank's main building at La Alameda park (Spanish Wikipedia).

name: Darb 1718 Contemporary Art and Culture Center
known: Non-profit art and culture centre in Fustat, Old Cairo, founded by the artist Moataz Nasr (Nasreldin or Nasr El-Din in some outlets).
The foundation prefers in-kind support such as computers, chairs, musical instruments and help building a new theatre (Bab Masr).

name: Medrar for Contemporary Art
known: Medrar's about page describes it as a non-profit art space running since 2005, thanks Dia Hamed as co-founder and lists Mohamed Allam as director.
The credits of the 9th festival (2019) list Mena El Shazly as artistic director (Cairo Video Festival acknowledgements).

name: Art D'Égypte
known: Founded by French-Egyptian curator and former art advisor Nadine Abdel Ghaffar in 2016 (designboom; a 2020 BMW press release gives 2017).

name: Museo de Arte de El Salvador (MARTE)
known: Eugenia Lindo is Executive Director and Jaime Izaguirre is Artistic Director (museum site).
Spanish Wikipedia says Eugenia Lindo has been executive director since 2020.

name: Museo de la Palabra y la Imagen (MUPI)
known: Founded by the Venezuelan journalist Carlos Henríquez Consalvi, who is also its director.
Director Carlos Henríquez Consalvi asked businesses and citizens to cover the loan instalments; donations for this are tax-deductible from income tax.

name: EKKM (Contemporary Art Museum of Estonia)
known: Its team since 2021 is Kadi Kesküla (administrative manager), Johannes Säre (technical manager), Laura Toots (project manager and curator) and Evelyn Raudsepp (creative producer) (Wikipedia).
By the end of 2021 it had held 76 exhibitions with 42 curators and 431 artists since 2007 (ERR, 2022).
